title: ННП-23 «Резчик» (GRAU 1ПН54) — Soviet day/night artillery observation device on tripod
era: developed 1981 (ОКР «Резчик», ЦКБ «Точприбор» Novosibirsk); serial production НПЗ (Новосибирский приборостроительный завод)

aiming_mechanics.value: elevation mechanism + elevation scale built into the instrument body; combined horizontal+vertical aiming mechanism with azimuth scale is a separate removable limb (лимб) between instrument and tripod; instrument carries its own compass (буссоль) and circular bubble level for horizontalization
aiming_mechanics.quote: Механизм наведения по вертикали и шкала… в корпусе прибора. Механизм наведения в горизонтальной и вертикальной плоскостях со шкалой для измерения азимутальных углов выполнен съемным… Прибор снабжен буссолью и уровнем

controls.value: day/night branch switch, neutral density filter (day branch), closable objective shutters (night branch), light shutter (световая шторка ЗАКРЫТО/ОТКР), power switch «В2» ВКЛ/ОТКЛ, image-sharpness focus handwheel (маховичок резкости), eyepiece diopter rings ±5 dpt, reticle brightness knob (ЯРКОСТЬ СЕТКИ, manual)
controls.src: npz_official (branch switch, filters, ручную регулировку яркости сетки); academy_slide7 (operating procedure steps, В2, шторка, маховичок резкости); user_photos (ЯРКОСТЬ СЕТКИ knob visible on left face)

eyecup_mount_mm.note: rubber eyecup seat diameter; binocular eyepieces

power.battery: АКБ 5Д-0,55С (6 V; К-316 container = 3×AA substitute), 10 h endurance
power.src: k316_battery; academy_slide6 'Время непрерывной работы без замены АКБ 10час'

kit.value: 1. Прибор наблюдения 2. Лимб 3. Тренога 4. Кожух на треногу 5. Ящик с приспособлениями (+BRDM bracket)

finish.value: sand-khaki (защитный желто-серый) enamel on instrument body and limb; darker olive tripod legs; black rubber eyecups; black bakelite knobs; small stencilled plates (1ПН 54 № serial, ВНИМАНИЕ warning block on upper body face)
finish.src: user_photos; academy_slide6 (photo-derived — exact paint spec in needs[])

features_inventory.value: boxy two-tier body: tall rear electronics box + objective drum (large cylinder) top-front; binocular eyepieces with rubber cups protrude low at the rear; ЯРКОСТЬ СЕТКИ knob + light-shutter lever on left face; В2 toggle + connector/battery box right-rear; warning text block on upper body face; 1ПН 54 stencil; removable limb with two fine-aiming handwheels under the body; tripod: crank column + 3 splayed legs with strap; transport = lidded wooden-style box
features_inventory.src: user_photos (all features visible); npz_official + academy_slide7 (control functions)

tripod_geometry.formula: photo-scaled from academy_slide6 full setup + user_photos using sourced body height 544 mm: total setup height ≈ 1.70 m, limb top (body bottom) ≈ 1.13 m, tripod head ≈ 0.84 m, leg foot spread radius ≈ 0.50 m → leg length ≈ 0.96 m at ~31° from vertical
tripod_geometry.note: tripod height nowhere stated in sources (needs[]); column is crank-adjustable so a fixed working height is a legitimate pose choice

optical_axes.formula: eyepiece axis = body bottom + ~100 mm (user_photos: eyecups at lower rear edge); objective axis = eyepiece axis + periscopicity 350 mm → 450 mm above body bottom, near body top (544 mm) — consistent with photos

objective_drum_mm.formula: objective housing outer Ø ≈ 210 mm — photo-scaled against sourced body width 245 mm (drum slightly narrower than body in front view); clamp band around drum ≈ 30 mm wide, slightly proud (user_photos: drum held by clamp ring with over-centre latch)

eyepiece_geometry_mm.formula: eyecup outer Ø ≈ 66 mm (42 mm sourced seat + rubber bell overhang); eyepiece tube Ø ≈ 40 mm; interpupillary spacing ≈ 65 mm (standard binocular IPD); black binocular bridge housing ≈ 115×70×55 spanning both tubes (user_photos: prominent black assembly at lower rear)

limb_handwheel_mm.formula: limb drum Ø ≈ 180 mm, handwheel Ø ≈ 55 mm — photo-scaled against body width 245 mm

controls_knobs_mm.formula: photo-scaled vs sourced body width 245 mm: ЯРКОСТЬ СЕТКИ knob Ø ≈ 34, light-shutter lever boss Ø ≈ 42, focus handwheel Ø ≈ 52, top filler cap Ø ≈ 44, battery/connector box on right face ≈ 55×130×110, tripod crank arm ≈ 85 long

movement_realism.summary: Full 360° azimuth slew (60-00) with fine handwheel traverse on the removable limb; elevation arc only ±3-00 (±300 mils ≈ ±18°) via handwheel in the body. No zoom — fixed 5×/5.5× magnification, day/night is a BRANCH SWITCH (separate optical paths), not a zoom. Setup ritual: level the limb by bubble, focus by handwheel on a distant object or star, set reticle brightness. Reticle illuminated with manual brightness control. Angles read out in Soviet mils (тысячные, Д-Ц format e.g. 0-10).
movement_realism.src: npz_official (angle ranges, branch switch, reticle brightness); academy_slide7 (procedure)

reticle.summary: Angle-measuring (угломерная) reticle for target location + range from known target dimensions; family pattern (ННП-21 predecessor) = binocular-style mil cross. Search snippets attribute 'большое деление 0-10 / малое 0-05' to 1ПН54 but unpinned (needs[]). Owner-supplied in-game reference: ПСО-style chevron + stadia rangefinder image — used as GAME reticle art, flagged representative.
reticle.src: stydopedia (angle measurement + range from known dims); sprotyvg7 Sumy textbook §2.8.6 (ННП-21 family reticle); user_photos (reticle reference image)
